text: William Kielar Jr. is a human flight master located at Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands. He is best known as the son of William Kielar who occupied the same space before he did.

Wildhammer Emissaries were Wildhammer dwarf Twin Peaks recruiters located at various spots throughout the largest Alliance cities - Stormwind City, Exodar, Darnassus, and Ironforge during the monthly Call to Arms: Twin Peaks.

Wildflame Point is an area in northeastern Molten Front near Widow's Clutch. It's from here several Druids of the Flame channel spells into the Azeroth-ending Solar Core or fly around in their fire hawk forms.

Wilhem Ken is a pandaren bread vendor in the Shrine of Seven Stars. He sits across a table from Michael Bedernik, who he frequently gets into an argument with. He appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight, already dead.
__NOTOC__ William Henderson is a human flight master located in Hearthglen in the Western Plaguelands.

Wildwood Wash is a subzone of Gorgrond that consists of a small Alliance outpost where players first enter the zone, a long road, and a destroyed dam that might be where the area gets its name. The area was an outpost by the Gorian Empire, but it was overtaken by time and/or the Primals. If there was a river here, it drained into the Crimson Fen. File:Wildwood Wash2.jpg|The ogre dam that probably gives the area its name. File:Wildwood Wash3.jpg|Where could this road have gone? What did the Overlook Ruins overlook?

Wileywisp Den is a small inn atop Sabermaw Bluff in Val'sharah. The inn is run by Gerdes the Drowsy whom stays in his bear form, and on the closest bed is vendor Kayklee in cat form. Next to the inn is a moonwell.
Wile-E is a wolf located at Lake Everstill in the Redridge Mountains.
Wildhammer Defenders are Wildhammer dwarves located in Shadowmoon Valley.
Wildhammer Scouts are Wildhammer dwarves located throughout Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley.
The Wildseed Cradle is looted from the Cache of the Moon in Ardenweald.
Wildmane is a druid located in the Verdant Wilds during Island Expeditions.
Willbreaker is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Wildzeal Wraps is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Will of the Berserker is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Berserker's Will.
Wilfred A. Stare is a worgen who participates in the Darkmoon dancing contest.
Wildfeather is a gryphon located at Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.
William Bassett is a voice actor who has provided several voices for the Warcraft universe.
Were you looking for: * found in Elwynn Forest * found in Silverpine Forest * found in Eastern Plaguelands * found in Sholazar Basin * found in Stormwind City * found in Howling Fjord
__NOTOC__ Windcaller Kaldon is a night elf quest giver located at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he briefly appeared in the Dreamgrove.
Wilma Ranthal is a human artisan skinning trainer located in Shalewind Canyon in the Redridge Mountains.

__NOTOC__ :"Some of our brethren prefer horses, but the hawkstrider will always be the true symbol of Silvermoon." Winaestra is a blood elf hawkstrider vendor located at Thuron's Livery in Eversong Woods.
Wily Fey Dragons are faerie dragons found in Stonetalon Peak in Stonetalon Mountains.
Wind Trader Mu'fah's Remains drop from Wind Trader Mu'fah at Moonrest Gardens in Dragonblight.
Wind-Up is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle. A hidden attribute is that the wind-up state persists through swaps, though the buff is only active for the pet that uses it.
William Warnecke is Lead Software Engineer, Support Systems working on Overwatch Live Operations, Automation and Reliability at Blizzard Entertainment.
Windflurry is a Windwalker monk ability, available at level 80. It increases the multistrike of nearby party and raid members by 5%.

Windmaster Julan was a Highmountain tauren and the main shaman for the Skyhorn tribe. During the harpy attack on Skyhorn, however, Julan was killed. Players are sent by Lasan Skyhorn to find Julan's smoldering corpse and use the wind totem he was carrying at the time of his death to put out the fires in the area. Lasan describes Julan as "a good shaman and full of life", and "not as morbid as some of these spiritwalkers", and says that he will miss his laughter.
Willy is a human boy living in Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains. He is a best friend of Aramar Thorne. They would play at the Lakeshire quarry. He and Stitch collected dead spiders.
Windburst is a Marksmanship hunter ability, learned from Thas'dorah, Legacy of the Windrunners.
Windcaller Ula'jan is a Zandalari troll located in Zuldazar. He is the troll responsible for moving Rastakhan's Might to Zeb'ahari with the power of the winds.
Wind Buffet is an ability used by battle pets during a Pet Battle.
The Windflight Knife is a quest reward from More Than Illness (Alliance).
Willowblossom is a faerie located in Ardenweald. She sacrificed herself to become a Vessel of Ardenweald in order to empower the Crest of Ascension in Bastion.
__NOTOC__ Windcaller Mariah is a taunka located in Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Willing Sacrifices are humans located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

Windborne Velocidrake is dragonriding mount that is a quest reward from Shady Sanctuary (quest). Obtaining this mount rewards the Together in the Skies. Additional customization can be unlocked by the drakewatcher manuscripts from various Dragonflight sources while the drake can be customized at a Rostrum of Transformation.

Windblessed Ohuna are ohuna located in the northeastern part of the Ohn'ahran Plains, north and west of the Mirewood Fen and just south of the border with the Waking Shores. Most are seen perched on cliffs, while others fly around the area. One of them periodically lands on top of the singing stone outside Timberstep Outpost.

__NOTOC__ Windwall Totem is a shaman ability. It applies a buff that decreases ranged damage (including critical hits) given to all party members near the totem. XX damage is subtracted from each ranged hit received. Windwall Totem decreases the damage before, not after, armor mitigation; therefore, the higher the armor value of a character, the less damage reduction will be received than is listed in the totem's description.
__NOTOC__ Winkey is the granddaughter of Gnopetto Bizzfuse, the creator of the Blingtron. She is a gnome located on a small island in Tanaris.
Windshear Crag once was a massive old-growth forest nestled in a valley in the Stonetalon Mountains.

__NOTOC__ Wing Commander Guse is an orc serving as wing commander of the Frostwolf clan in Alterac Valley. At the beginning of each match, she is held prisoner in Icewing Bunker. Guse and Mulverick were briefly seen at Frostwolf Village in Alterac Valley and later made their way to Razor Hill in Durotar to participate in the first Azerothian Kosh'harg festival.

Winstone Wolfe is a human found in Ravenholdt Manor in the Alterac Mountains. As of the Cataclysm, he has taken Fahrad's place in offering the only repeatable quest for Ravenholdt reputation, Junkboxes Needed. He is recruited by the Uncrowned and is seen in the Chamber of Shadows in the Hall of Shadows. Players visit him for Order Advancements.
__NOTOC__ Wing Commander Gryphongar is a dwarf quest giver located at Shatter Point in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Windyreed Village is the village of the Windyreed Lost One tribe. Many of them are fishermen. It lies just below the High Path up to Shattrath City, in eastern Nagrand.
__NOTOC__ Wing Commander Nuainn Stormwing is a Wildhammer dwarf located at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley.
__NOTOC__ Windshear Geomancers were kobolds found in Stonetalon Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Windshear Overlords were kobolds overseeing the miners in Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Windstalker Ifram is an ethereal rogue trainer located at the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.

Windshear Valley is a forested valley within the Windshear Crag of the Stonetalon Mountains. The Northwatch Expeditionary Unit control this valley currently and have cleared most of the wildlife that once lived here. Now, besides the Alliance, only Stonetalon Rams are here. Prior to the Cataclysm this valley was simply part of the Windshear Crag and was inhabited by spiders and thunder lizards.

The Winged Guardian serves both as a flying and a ground mount depending on the terrain. When you take to the skies astride a blazing, eagle-winged lion, your comrades will know you mean business. Serious business. The majestic Winged Guardian is a titan creation from Uldum that was designed to protect Azeroth’s most ancient secrets. This Guardian of the Titans will carry you across Azeroth as fast as your riding skill will take you.
Windshear Overseers are Horde goblins found in the Windshear Mine of the Stonetalon Mountains.

Windshear Heights is a wyvern habitat located east of the Mirkfallon Lake in the Stonetalon Mountains. Since the construction of the Sludgewerks on the lake, the Heights has become one of the largest remaining nesting areas for the Pridewing Wyverns.
__NOTOC__ Windswept Balloons are found floating around in Stormwind City and Orgrimmar.
Windwalk Totem is a talented shaman ability, available at level 30.

Windstorm was a hippogryph of the green and orange variant who was used by Aradria Cloudflyer to get to Darnassus. They were struck down en route by Garrosh Hellscream's orcs. Windstorm tried to defend Aradria and battle with the orcs, however he was killed. Later his body was found by a supply train and brought to Commander Haldrissa Woodshaper. Aradria called him a loyal friend.
Windshear Diggers were kobolds located in Stonetalon Mountains.
Windshear Stonecutters were kobolds found in Stonetalon Mountains.
Windshear Tunnel Rats were kobolds located in Stonetalon Mountains.
Windshear Vermin were kobolds located in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Wing Nga is a pandaren flight master found in Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Winter's Blossom is the first line of defense of the Ox Gate of the Serpent's Spine in northwest Kun-Lai Summit. Accessed from the southeast at the Kota Basecamp, travelers pass through the Shado-Li Basin between Kota Peak and Mount Neverest to reach the small camp. From there, adventurers can travel up the mountain path to reach the Shado-Pan Monastery.
Wing Hya is a pandaren flight master located on the hilltop level of Honeydew Village in the Jade Forest.
Wing Kyo is the flight master located at Paw'don Village in the contested territory of The Jade Forest.
Winged Swampserpents are located at the Blind Marshlands in Highmountain.
Windscar Whetstone drops from Advisor Melandrus in Court of Stars.
__NOTOC__ Winter's Kiss is found in snowy areas in Kul Tiras; typically on mountains.
Windtamer Loka is a Highmountain tauren located at Swiftwind Post in Drustvar.
__NOTOC__ Wingleader Srak'ik is a mantid that can be encountered during Island Expeditions.

The Windswept Pass lies on the northwestern coast of Vol'dun and is cut off by Shatterstone Harbor in the west, Bwoljin's Fall in the southeast, Redsilt Wash in the north, and an unnamed riverbed in the east. A large number of Zandalari Exiles roam the area.

Winds of Wisdom was an experience boost buff that was applied to all player characters at level 119 or below from 20 March 2020 through to the release of the Shadowlands pre-patch, in light of the . The Impressive Influence buff eventually followed. The buff returned with 50% (down from 100%) on 20 July 2022, lasting through August 1st in preparation for Shadowlands Season 4. And once again on 4 October 2022, lasting until Dragonflights pre-expansion patch.
Windshear Huntresses are freed night elves that accompany the player in the Stonetalon Mountains during Free Our Sisters.
Winds of Bastion is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Wing Guard Aela is a gladiator flight master located at the Spearhead in Maldraxxus.
Windy is a faerie located at Star Lake Amphitheater in Ardenweald. He plays two roles during Break a Leg and The Fourth Wall, er, War: "Illidan " and "Anduin ."
Windswept Visor is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Winged Medallion is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Winged Curio is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

The Windswept Aerie is the southwestern extent of the mainland of Korthia. The ridge lies above the Estuary of Awakening to the north, and is across an impassible mountain from the Seeker's Quorum to the east. The mouth of Gromit Hollow is at and is marked on the map

Winter's Sigil concludes the seventh chapter of the Chains of Domination campaign, "The Power of Night", though there is a breadcrumb back to Korthia next. The penultimate chapter begins back at Keeper's Respite in Korthia at Renown (Shadowlands) 56, with Thenios offering A Paladin's Soul.
The Windsoul Totem is provided as an objective for The Power of the Elements.
Windspeaker's Lava Resurgence is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Windspeaker's Lava Resurgence.

Winged Soul Eaters are soul eaters ridden by Maw guards flying around the Crucible in Oribos during the aerial battle in A Hasty Voyage. Halfway through the battle, the player and Pelagos get knocked off their Anima Wyrm and hijack one of the Winged Soul Eaters instead (knocking its unfortunate rider off in the process) and use it to ride through the portal to Zereth Mortis before it closes. The Soul Eater dies in the process and its corpse permanently remains lying on the Path of Inception as a reminder of how players first reached the realm.

The Wings of Awakening is an ensemble of dragon wings available in five color variants that represents each primary dragonflight. They are obtained by purchasing 's Collector's Edition or Epic Edition.

Windsage Garuman is a centaur of Clan Ohn'ir, assigned to serve as advisor to Clan Nokhud, who appears in the Nokhud encampment in Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains during Unwelcome Outsider. He accuses the Nokhud leader Balakar Khan of betraying Ohn'ahra by working with the Primalists; in response, Balakar, egged on by Koroleth, kills Garuman with a blast of storm magic. Garuman's body remains at the base of the hill where he fell and can optionally be interacted with to unlock new dialogue with Tigari Khan (who describes Garuman as a "devoted but troubled man" who'd tried to warn the Ohn'ir of Balakar) and his betrothed Windsage Contan (who promises to avenge his death).
Windscourge Drakes are proto-drakes located flying around the Stormsunder Crater in the Forbidden Reach. Some are ridden by Trueborn Rainmakers.

__NOTOC__ Winter is the young frost wolf companion of Durak. They are first seen alongside Spring, Moonpaw, and Ryala in Frostwolf Keep in Alterac Valley during A People in Need of Healing. While accompanying the player character during The Blessing of the Ancestors onward, Durak rides Winter as his ground mount.
Windstrike is a shaman ability. It replaces Stormstrike while using Ascendance as an Enhancement shaman.

Windtossed Feathers are located in the Roaring Dragonsprings in the Ohn'ahran Plains. They are the feathers of the wild eagles and contain their magic for quite some time. Clan Aylaag uses them in initiation rituals for new members of their tribe.
Winged Agility is a pet ability available exclusively to the wind serpent family of hunter pets, increasing pet dodge chance by 30%.

Winterspring (also known as Winterspring Valley) is a snowy valley located in Northern Kalimdor, east of Felwood, northeast of Mount Hyjal, and north of Azshara. It holds the goblin trading post of Everlook, old night elf ruins, and the vast cave Mazthoril, the primary home of the blue dragonflight on Kalimdor. Many wild creatures roam this beautiful landscape.
Witchblade was a One-Hand Dagger mainly for magic-users with its intellect bonus and additional spell damage. It was most likely named after a comic of the same name.
The Wisdom of the Timbermaw is a Tailoring-crafted belt that gives a bonus to mana regeneration. This makes it great for priests and druids who act as main healer.

The Winterfall tribe of furbolgs inhabit the snowy mountains of Winterspring. Adapted to their environment, most of them have white fur, though some also have brown fur like other tribes. Their largest settlement is Winterfall Village in the far east of Winterspring, near Everlook, where their chieftain High Chief Winterfall once resided. They conquered Timbermaw Post in western Winterspring, and often travel to the hot springs nearby. They are allied with the Deadwood furbolgs of Felwood. Former allies of the Timbermaw tribe, they have grown increasingly aggressive to them and the other inhabitants of Winterspring. As Salfa explains, they are now at war, so killing Winterfall furbolgs will
Winterfall E'ko is required for the quest Winterfall E'ko (quest). You can turn in three of these for one Juju Power.

Witch Doctor Jin'Zil is a jungle troll quest giver located at Malaka'jin in the Stonetalon Mountains. He is an old friend of Darsok Swiftdagger and Rokhan. Before the Cataclysm, Jin'Zil was located inside the cave in the eastern part of Malaka'jin, surrounded by cages holding Prisoners of Jin'Zil.

__NOTOC__ Witch Hill is an area in Dustwallow Marsh, located about a third of the way down the peninsula on the way to Theramore Island (or northwest from there). Near its center is Swamplight Manor, home of "Swamp Eye" Jarl. It also contains a few camps of the Mirefin murloc tribe. Witch Hill is haunted by the demon Zelfrax.

Winterax Hold is the former home of Winterax tribe of ice trolls in Alterac Valley. It is located in the mountains around Snowfall Graveyard. Due to an avalanche, most of the Winterax Hold was blocked off from the rest of Alterac Valley. Korrak the Bloodrager and a few of his followers survived the avalanche and managed to defend the Snowfall Graveyard a bit longer. However, after the release of patch 1.10, they left Alterac Valley looking for greener pastures. This area reappears during Korrak's Revenge.

The Winterfang tribe is an ice troll tribe that also lives in Northrend alongside the Drakkari. Winterfangs are smaller than Drakkari trolls, more akin to jungle trolls in size and stature. Kril, a member of the Winterfang tribe, hates and envies the Drakkari because of their power. He schemed against Malakk and the Drakkari. His chieftain, Shakor, discovered his plans and was infuriated, for Kril’s actions could have brought the wrath of the Drakkari on the Winterfangs. Shakor could have killed Kril, but the two are cousins, so Shakor instead demanded an apology. Kril did apologize, though with poor grace. After which Kril absented himself, becoming Kril'fon (he claimed to have discovered s

Wintergarde Mine was a mine controlled by the 7th Legion until the Scourge overran it, raising the miners within. It is found next to Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight. Alliance players are tasked with destroying the entrances and recovering samples of a strange, dark ore that was found merely a few hours before the invasion.

The Winterfin tribe are a tribe of murlocs led by King Mrgl-Mrgl. This tribe is friendly to both factions and sells some items once you have completed several quests. After completing the quest Learning to Communicate, King Mrgl-Mrgl will create a spell that enables you to speak the murloc dialect of the Winterfin tribe. The Winterfins value clams above all other objects, and those are used as currency in their society. Unfortunately for the tribe, an evil makrura named Claximus has been terrorizing them and has stolen their children. Many of the adult murlocs who went after Claximus in the Winterfin Caverns succumbed to magical emanations from Coldarra; this has affected their minds and all

Witch Doctor Khufu is a Zandalari troll quest giver located at Zim'Torga in Zul'Drak. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard visited Zim'Torga, and Magni Bronzebeard had a long talk with Khufu about shamanism. During their discussion about the Drakkari and their sacrifices, he also told the dwarves that: “The power they gained from killing the natural gods of the land is transitory. What was gained in the short run will be lost to them for all eternity.”

This Feat of Strength achievement is gained by acquiring a mount, and is limited to Alliance faction members. There is a corresponding achievement available to the Horde. This can be done by gaining reputation with the Wintersaber Trainers faction, then purchasing the mount from Rivern Frostwind in Winterspring.

__NOTOC__ Witch Doctor Hez'tok took part in Zalazane's Fall as a level 80. After Vol'jin had sounded the call to arms Hez'tok joined his chieftain in Sen'jin Village along with Vanira, Champion Uru'zin, Zild'jian and other members of the Horde. Hez'tok proceeded to speak with the spirits, and arranged an alliance with the ancient Darkspear Loa of the dead, Bwonsamdi. This powerful ally and his army of dead Darkspear warriors proved fruitful and eventually lead to the death of the traitorous Zalazane enabling the tribe to reclaim the Echo Isles. Hez'tok later participated in the Faction Assault on Drustvar.
Witch Doctor's Spaulders is a quest reward from Doin' De E'ko Magic.
Wispy Foxflowers can be found in Highmountain on the Broken Isles. They are a variant of Foxflower with wispy tips that are gentle to the touch.
Witch-Harpy Talon can be obtained in bonus chests from Class Hall missions. It is also a quest reward from normal Highmountain world quests.
__NOTOC__ Winterfin Warriors are murlocs located at Winterfin Village in the Borean Tundra. They are aggressive due to being controlled by Claximus by using the seeping magic from Coldarra.
Wintergrasp Fighter Planes could originally be used as flying vehicles in Wintergrasp during the Wrath of the Lich King beta.
Wintergrasp Bombers could originally be used as flying vehicles in Wintergrasp during the Wrath of the Lich King beta.
Summer Scorchlings and Festival Scorchling briefly transform into Wisps of Ragnaros upon the completion of Incense for the Summer Scorchlings and Incense for the Festival Scorchlings respectively.
Wisdom and Fury is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Wisdom's Embrace is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Winterwoven Branches is a cosmetic back piece sold by Master Clerk Salorn for at Star Lake Amphitheater in Ardenweald.
The Winterscale Spaulders are an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Jorundall Salvage.
The Winterscale Waistguard is an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Jorundall Salvage.

Winter Wilderling Harness is a wilderling flying mount sold by Duchess Mynx for 1000 Stygia at Keeper's Respite in Korthia, for Night Fae Covenant players who have reached standing with Death's Advance and earned the achievement On the Offensive (achievement).
The Wintergarde Gryphon Whistle is provided as an objective for Flight of the Wintergarde Defender. Using it summons a Wintergarde Gryphon.
Witch Doctor's Wolf Bones is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Witch Doctor.

Winterpelt Hollow is a furbolg camp in northeastern Azure Span. The home of the Winterpelt Furbolg clan, the camp is bisected by a frozen river. At the north end of the river is a small ice cave, where the leader of the clan, Kranac Sagesnow has his seat. The area is bordered by an impassible mountain range to the north on the border with Thaldraszus, the east and south by the Upper Frostlands, the southwest by Theron's Watch, and to the west by the Misty Canyon and Misty Canyon Overlook.

The Wizard's Sanctum is a mage tower and a portal room located in the central-southern part of the Mage Quarter, in Stormwind City. With patch 8.1.5, the tower's interior was completely revamped to house the Stormwind Portal Room, the mages of Stormwind and their allies maintain portals to a number of different areas on Azeroth, Outland, and that had previously been scattered throughout the capital, while portals to the Shadowlands and the Dragon Isles have recently been implemented. Though the personnel working here are generally affiliated with Stormwind, decorations such as the insignia at its entrance suggest the Kirin Tor helped with the remodeling. The area is patrolled by arcane golem

:WoWBench is unfortunately out of date. It's not entirely abandoned -- there's a few of us wanting to get back on it but we keep getting sidetracked. --Mikk (T) 18:38, 23 January 2008 (UTC) WoWBench aims to be a near-complete "emulation of the World of Warcraft API". AddOn development in WoW can be somewhat strained at times due the near-total lack of in-game debugging capabilities. Added to that, the time it takes to test each change is fairly long. WoWBench enables AddOn developers to test most of their functionality offline, in a controlled environment where they can fire game events at their own leisure, with content that they choose. It also features a "built-in commandline debugger" wi
The Witherbark Coin is a Paragon of Power sought after by the Zandalar Tribe.

WoWRP was started on April 30th, 2006 by Elüna of Defias Brotherhood as a community driven website for everyone playing on RP and RP-PVP servers. The nature of the site would be as a sanctuary for roleplaying enthusiasts all over the world who play World of Warcraft. Members include players from both US and European servers. Users are invited to post original content such as character information, original lore, and stories, in addition to articles that may be used as references for roleplayers seeking more information related to roleplaying in the World of Warcraft universe.

WoWDB is a World of Warcraft information database intended as an accessory to MMO-Champion and as a successor to its previous [https://web.archive.org/web/20120225093954/http://db.mmo-champion.com/ database], which was not "aging very well". It is currently in a "late alpha/early beta" state. WoWDB was acquired by Magic Find along with MMO-Champion on 11 June 2019. It has been -current as of 2022, lacking information on and .

WoW's 4th Anniversary is a Feat of Strength for being an account holder at midnight 23 November 2008. After receiving the achievement, players received a companion in the mail attached to the following letter:
With Open Arms (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Kologarn without destroying either of his arms on 10-player mode.
Withered Reavers are quilboar located in Razorfen Downs. They are slightly more powerful versions of the Withered Warriors.

WoW's 5th Anniversary is a Feat of Strength achievement gained by logging on to World of Warcraft between November 22 and December 6, 2009. After receiving it, players received an Onyxian Whelpling in the mail attached to the following letter:
Wizardry is a passive ability for Mages that increases Intellect by 5%, learned at level 50.
WoW's 6th Anniversary is a Feat of Strength achievement gained by logging on to World of Warcraft between November 30 and December 14, 2010. Recipients were mailed the following letter: __NOTOC__

WoW's 7th Anniversary is a Feat of Strength achievement gained by logging on to World of Warcraft between November 20 and December 3, 2011. Recipients were mailed a Celebration Package attached to the following letter: __NOTOC__

WoW's 8th Anniversary is a Feat of Strength achievement gained by logging on to World of Warcraft during the 8th Anniversary celebration period from November 18, 2012 to December 2, 2012. Recipients were mailed a Celebration Package attached to the following letter: __NOTOC__

WoW's 9th Anniversary is a Feat of Strength achievement gained by logging on to World of Warcraft between November 18 and December 1, 2013. Players awarded this achievement received a Celebration Package in the mail attached to the following letter: __NOTOC__

WoW's 10th Anniversary is a Feat of Strength achievement earned for logging in during the 10th anniversary of World of Warcraft between November 21, 2014 to January 5, 2015. This anniversary had a temporary Tarren Mill vs Southshore 40vs40 battleground, a temporary Raid Finder-style revamp of the Molten Core raid to obtain the Core Hound Chain mount, a chance at the Hatespark the Tiny pet, and a small chance at the Flames of Ragnaros from Ragnaros. Everyone also received a Molten Corgi pet in the mail.

WoW's 11th Anniversary is a Feat of Strength achievement earned for logging in during the 11th anniversary of World of Warcraft between November 16, 2015 to November 30, 2015. Everyone will receive a Anniversary Gift (old) in the mail, which contains: * Inflatable Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker * Exquisite Costume Set: "Edwin VanCleef" * Celebration Wand - Gnoll * Celebration Wand - Murloc * Celebration Package
The Withered Suramar Citizen is a withered located in Suramar City.
The Witchwood is a forest found in northern Highmountain, controlled by harpies. An ettin wanders in these woods. The Bloodtotem tauren possess an outpost nearby named Cliff's Edge.

WoW's 12th Anniversary is a Feat of Strength achievement earned for logging in during the 12th anniversary of World of Warcraft between November 16, 2016 to November 30, 2016. Everyone who logged in received a Anniversary Gift (old) in the mail, which contained: * Timewarped Badge x200 * Letter from the Timewalkers * Celebration Package

The Withered Army Training scenario starts with Thalyssra in Shal'Aran. Your mission is to lead a squad of withered into a special instance of Falanaar to defeat monsters and retrieve chests which upgrade your army. The primary reason to run the scenario is to gain reputation with the Nightfallen, although you can gain Artifact Power, Order Resources and other things. The scenario is on a 3-day lockout, much like the now-removed Zul'Gurub 20-man raid.

WoW's 13th Anniversary is a Feat of Strength achievement earned for logging in during the 13th anniversary of World of Warcraft between November 16, 2017 to November 30, 2017. Everyone who logged in received a Anniversary Gift (old) in the mail, which contained: *Celebration Package *Timewarped Badge x200 *A Slightly More Urgent Letter from the Timewalkers *Letter from the Timewalkers (if not completed in previous years)
__NOTOC__ Withering Citizens are nightborne located in Suramar City.
Withered Soldiers are withered located in Suramar City during A Challenge From Our Enemies.
The Witherbranch clan is a clan of jungle trolls assaulting islands in search of :Azerite.

WoW's 14th Anniversary is the Feat of Strength achievement earned for logging in during the 14th anniversary of World of Warcraft between November 16, 2018 to November 30, 2018. Wizbang's Island Treasure Shop was a Goblin Merchant in the area of Tidefury Cove, on an isle.

World PvP refers to Player vs. Player activities taking place in the wider game world, rather than in a battleground, Arena or PvP zone. World PvP may refer to organised or spontaneous activities, but does not refer to duels. World PvP usually refers to spontaneous combat between two or more players, simply for the thrill of battle. However, certain zones feature specific objectives which encourage world PvP, either through their placement or through offering bonuses to players of the faction which currently controls those objectives, or even by directly rewarding PvP kills. World of Warcraft: Chronicle Volume 1 is the first of the four books in the Chronicle series which attempts to codify, tighten up and clarify the history of Warcraft. It released on March 15th, 2016. The first volume goes from the creation of the Warcraft universe up until the story of The Last Guardian, slightly before the First War. The authors are Matt Burns, Robert Brooks, and Chris Metzen, with full-color illustrations by Peter Lee and additional artwork by Joseph Lacroix.

As such, the enemy (at least during the early parts of the scenario) will be the opposite faction, a "vast army of world-destroying forces".
